data.gender_notes: Usa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aphrodite-Usas, meaning 'Strong and Compassionate'. In Greek mythology, Usas was a goddess of strength and the protector of the islands. In Christianity, the name Usa represents the strong, compassionate nature of God. The name Usa carries the meaning “Strong, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Usa usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the strength and compassion of God.
data.etymology: Usa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Usa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
